name: Ichimoku Cloud Trend Following — CL Futures
description: Trend-following strategy on WTI crude oil futures (CL) using Ichimoku Cloud signals. Long entry on bullish TK cross (Tenkan crosses above Kijun) when both lines are above the Kumo cloud. Short entry on bearish TK cross when both lines are below cloud. Exits via 2x ATR(14) trailing stop or reversal on opposite signal. Fixed position size of 1 contract per trade. Standard Ichimoku parameters (9/26/52). Daily timeframe.
source:
# Ichimoku Cloud Trend-Following Strategy on CL Futures
# Entry: Bullish/bearish TK cross with Tenkan & Kijun above/below cloud
# Exit: 2x ATR(14) trailing stop or reversal on opposite signal
# Position: 1 contract per signal
# Ichimoku: standard 9/26/52 parameters

# --- Data Source ---
src = market_data_source(timeframe=1D)()
cont = futures_continuation(s_rollover_method=RolloverType.FirstOfMonth, s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.BackwardPanamaCanal)(src.o, src.h, src.l, src.c, src.v, src.oi, src.s)

# --- Ichimoku Cloud ---
ichi = ichimoku(p_tenkan=9, p_kijun=26, p_senkou_b=52)(cont.h, cont.l, cont.c)
tenkan = ichi.tenkan
kijun = ichi.kijun
senkou_a = ichi.senkou_a
senkou_b = ichi.senkou_b

# --- Cloud boundaries ---
# Cloud top = max(Senkou A, Senkou B), cloud bottom = min(Senkou A, Senkou B)
cloud_top = senkou_a if senkou_a > senkou_b else senkou_b
cloud_bottom = senkou_a if senkou_a < senkou_b else senkou_b

# --- Lag all signal components by 1 bar to avoid look-ahead bias ---
tenkan_prev = tenkan >> 1
kijun_prev = kijun >> 1
cloud_top_prev = cloud_top >> 1
cloud_bottom_prev = cloud_bottom >> 1

# --- TK Cross signals (using lagged values) ---
# Bullish: Tenkan crosses above Kijun
tk_cross_bull = crossover(tenkan_prev, kijun_prev)
# Bearish: Tenkan crosses below Kijun
tk_cross_bear = crossunder(tenkan_prev, kijun_prev)

# --- Cloud position filters (both lines must be above/below cloud) ---
above_cloud = (tenkan_prev > cloud_top_prev) and (kijun_prev > cloud_top_prev)
below_cloud = (tenkan_prev < cloud_bottom_prev) and (kijun_prev < cloud_bottom_prev)

# --- Entry signals (pulse + filter → use hold_until to persist state) ---
# Raw pulse: crossover/crossunder AND cloud filter
long_pulse = tk_cross_bull and above_cloud
short_pulse = tk_cross_bear and below_cloud

# Hold bullish state from TK bull cross until TK bear cross
long_state = hold_until()(enter=tk_cross_bull, exit=tk_cross_bear)
# Hold bearish state from TK bear cross until TK bull cross
short_state = hold_until()(enter=tk_cross_bear, exit=tk_cross_bull)

# Entry: state active AND cloud filter confirms
long_entry = long_state and above_cloud
short_entry = short_state and below_cloud

# --- ATR for trailing stop ---
atr_val = atr(period=14)(cont.h, cont.l, cont.c)
trail_distance = atr_val * 2.0

# --- Execution ---
rollover_policy()(active=cont.s)
long_and_short_zone()(long_entry=long_entry, short_entry=short_entry)
position_size(type=SizeType.unit)(size=1)
trailing_stop()(distance=trail_distance)
